text:
alice: customer (acme-inc) reporting lots of 504s from hosted inference in eu-west-1, just got escalated by support.
maria: which service / route? any request ids we can trace?
alice: /v1/generate stream requests. gateway shows 502 then 504 after ~20-35s. sample log:
```
2026-03-12T12:03:11Z gateway INFO req=rid-7c2a vhost=acme route=/v1/generate backend=svc-inference status=502 latency=12.4ms
2026-03-12T12:03:12Z gateway INFO req=rid-7c2a retry -> routed to svc-inference-2 status=504 latency=30001ms
```
kevin: I pulled KEDA/metrics for that scaledobject. suspicious config: triggerMetadata uses "queue-length" while our exporter emits "queue_depth". KEDA never saw the queue rise until it was huge.
oncall-sre: can you paste the scaledobject/HPA output?
kevin: here — trimmed:
```
kubectl get scaledobject inference-acme -o yaml
  triggers:
    - type: azure-queue
      metadata:
        queue-length: "5"    # <- wrong key
---
kubectl get hpa inference-deployment -o jsonpath='{.status}':
  currentReplicas: 0
  desiredReplicas: 0
```
ops-bot: alert: high_rate_5xx service=svc-inference acme-inc region=eu-west-1 count=120 window=5m
support-ian: customer says timeouts happen most when they ramp burst traffic from 10->200 concurrent streaming calls; they see 30s client side timeouts.
maria: also saw readinessProbe for model pod takes ~40s because model init downloads a 600MB shard on cold start. combined with zero minReplicas -> slow ramp.
oncall-sre: repro steps I used (quick):
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://api.redwood/inference/v1/generate &
done
```
that produced a backlog and subsequent 504s in ~90s.
kevin: root cause summary: metric key mismatch prevented KEDA trigger; scaledobject minReplica=0 meant no warm pods; model init time + readiness delay caused requests to hit gateway which queued and timed out.
maria: quick mitigation applied: patched scaledobject triggerMetadata to use "queue_depth", set minReplica=2, and set a prewarm annotation to instantiate 1 pod per zone.
```
kubectl patch scaledobject inference-acme --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/triggers/0/metadata/queue-length","value":"queue_depth"}]'
kubectl patch deployment inference-deployment -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```
alice: rolled the patch at 12:25 UTC, metrics show scale to 3 pods within 30s and 5xx rate dropped back to baseline :thumbsup:
support-ian: customer verified reduced 504s after mitigation, will keep monitoring for 24h.
oncall-sre: followups: create e2e synthetic that ramps streaming requests (10->200 in 60s), add alert if queue_depth>50 for >2m, reduce readinessProbe timeout or prefetch shards earlier in image startup. filing ticket INF-9142 for remediation.
kevin: extra note — found metrics exporter had intermittent 401s against billing service which caused metric scrapes to stall and underreport queue. created billing-ticket BT-3321 to track auth retry fix.
maria: thanks team — closing incident channel once postmortem pinned and INF-9142 created. :white_check_mark:
